Take this as your sign to give back and volunteer! Brooklyn Org’s (@bklynorg) annual day of service brings together the community for a day of volunteering across the borough. We’re talking park cleanups, mural painting, sorting donated books and clothing, urban farming and more. There are so many ways to show up and make a difference, and learn about some amazing non-profits along the way. Sign up for the volunteer day at Brooklyn.org/volunteerday. Some projects: · Sure We Can – Recycling · Black Trans Femmes in the Arts – Studio Beautification Project · Asiyah Women’s Center Free Store – Staffing The Free Store · The B.R.O. Experience Foundation – Mural Painting & Packing “Bro Kits” · Surveillance Technology Oversight Project – Phone Banking Advocacy Plus, we’re giving away Brooklyn Org swag boxes to 3 lucky winners! HOW TO ENTER 1. FOLLOW @nyc_forfree and @bklynorg 2. LIKE this Post 3. TAG a friend to volunteer with! 1 comment = 1 entry. You can enter as many times as you’d like! Each SEPARATE TAG = a new entry, unlimited entries allowed! This will end on April 22nd at 11:59pm EST. Three winners will be selected randomly and announced via stories the next day. Please beware of any spam accounts that contact you and ask for information. We will post the winner on stories. This is not sponsored, endorsed, administered by, or associated with Instagram.
